title: India just registered a record number of electric two-wheelers in a single month. November 1, 2026.
excerpt: From a state born twice on the same calendar date, to an India-trained engineer elected to America's medical academy, to a record month for electric scooters, to a Manipur craftswoman whose workshop now employs 50 artists - November 1's four stories are about things that get built once and then keep getting rebuilt, stronger, on the same foundation.
bodyHtml:
Every story today returns to the same date, the same training ground, or the same workshop - and builds something larger the second time around.

On November 1, a state was born. Seventeen years later, on the same date, it got its modern name

Karnataka Rajyotsava marks November 1, 1956, when Kannada-speaking regions from Bombay, Madras, Hyderabad and Coorg were merged into Mysore State under the States Reorganisation Act. On November 1, 1973 - exactly 17 years later - it was renamed Karnataka, a resolution moved by Chief Minister D. Devaraj Urs.

He built drug-delivery technology now in clinical trials. In 2026, America's medical academy took notice

Ashutosh Chilkoti, born in India and a 1985 B.Tech graduate of IIT Delhi, was elected to the US National Academy of Medicine's 2026 class on October 19, recognized for developing the first artificial polypeptides to enter clinical trials for sustained protein-drug delivery.

India just registered a record number of electric two-wheelers in a single month

VAHAN registration data shows 223,886 electric two-wheelers registered in October 2026 - up 48% year-on-year. TVS led the market with its best-ever month, followed by Bajaj Auto, Ather Energy, Hero MotoCorp and Ola Electric.

She runs a bamboo and wood craft unit in Manipur that employs more than 50 artists - and the Prime Minister noticed

Margaret Ramtharsiem, from Churachandpur district, built a traditional bamboo and wood craft enterprise that now employs over 50 artists and reaches markets as far as Delhi, while training new artisans for free. PM Modi featured her in Mann Ki Baat on December 28, 2025.

Four stories, one pattern: a state reshaped by agreement, an engineer's training feeding directly into global medicine, a sector's growth curve bending faster each month, and a workshop that turned one woman's craft into fifty people's livelihoods.
